rule.precedence: RUN-BLOCKED -> QUALITY-GAIN (only if the optional B=16 GPTQ comparison completed validly) -> balancing classes
rule.RUN-BLOCKED: a generator correctness gate fails, the 16 x 512 pilot does not complete for BOTH methods, a generated set is invalid (not 16 distinct full 512-token sequences of real ids), or resources prevent the measurement
rule.MODEL-MATCHED-EBSS-QUALITY-GAIN: B=16 GPTQ valid for all configs AND EBSS mean reconstruction is lower than Probability-Only by >= 0.5 % AND lower than every C4 Random B=16 seed AND >= 0.5 % lower than the C4 Random seed mean
rule.MODEL-MATCHED-EBSS-BALANCING-SUPPORTED: EBSS set-level paper sigma (Eq. 3/4, all 24 MoE layers) AND mean per-layer load CV (all 24 layers) are both lower than Probability-Only
rule.MODEL-MATCHED-EBSS-BALANCING-NOT-SUPPORT: neither is lower (EBSS equal or worse on both)
rule.MODEL-MATCHED-EBSS-MIXED: exactly one of the two balance metrics is lower
rule.notes: set-level metrics over the 16 x 512 = 8,192 tokens of each set; lower-tail exposure (min / p5 / p10 / zero-exposure experts), per-layer results and layers 1/8/16/23 are reported separately and do not enter the label. With exactly k = 4 routed experts per token the per-layer mean count is fixed, so sigma_l and CV_l are proportional within a layer; the two means can still differ only through layer weighting (ddof differs). One seed, one start-token draw: no statistical generality.

scope: 16 x 512 pilot, one seed, one start-token draw; not full-budget EBSS effectiveness
